_about: Regression reference for linux-64: the SAME values as osx-arm64 (legacy macOS toolchain, 2026-11-12). A Linux install must reproduce the macOS results within these tolerances: cross-platform equivalence.
_note_mesh: fea-cantilever node counts are a mesh fingerprint, not an engineering answer: Gmsh's parallel HXT 3D mesher is not deterministic (M5: run-to-run differences on macOS; up to 2.2% on 2-core CI runners with benchmarks in parallel). They catch a mesher change at +-5%; the physical results (tip deflection, stress, reaction) keep their tight tolerances.
